Name of the cell in the authors' data, where the authors provide cell names (Sa2020: set exactly for the cells of the authors' main analysis)
Number of UMIs of the cell (rRNA genes excluded)
Number of genes detected in the cell
Host and tissue of the sample: Host blood, Host liver or Vector salivary gland
Geographic origin of the parasite strain or isolate
Hazzard2024 infection design (single strain, consecutive, simultaneous, sporozoite infection)
What the replicate is: animal or infection
Sequencing instrument registered for the run
Stage assigned by the authors (Sa2020 gametocytes, liver forms of Ruberto2022_1 and Mancio-Silva2022, sporozoite samples)

Life-cycle stage: the authors' stage if given, else the cluster gametocyte call, else idc_stage
Where stage comes from: author, gametocyte_markers or idc_reference
Time point (hours) of the reference blood-stage time course most similar to the cell (SingleR label); blood cells with at least 20 UMIs only
SingleR delta to the next best time point
TRUE if SingleR's pruning (default settings) would discard idc_timepoint as unreliable
Louvain cluster on the integrated data, resolution 0.05
Cluster in the blood-stage clustering (stage 35; blood cells with at least 20 UMIs only)
Gametocyte call (female or male) of the cell's blood-stage cluster
State along the sexual branch: Developing gametocyte, Early female, Late female, Early male, Late male
Module score of the female gametocyte markers
Module score of the male gametocyte markers
